summary: Iteration-3 revision: resolved all 7 reviewer findings (2 high, 3 medium, 2 low). G2-01: added S2-P3-01..S2-P3-05 to excluded_scenarios[] in test-manifest.json with per-scenario consolidation justification (which Phase-1/2 test covers each). G2-02: added TADR-S2-03 to tactical-adrs.md documenting integration-only normalizer branch coverage decision; manifest normalizer_coverage_decision now references TADR-S2-03. G2-03: AC-22 describe block changed from beforeAll to beforeEach; each test resets EmployeeSkill to SELF_REPORTED baseline so S2-P2-04 SELF_REPORTED→VERIFIED transition is genuinely exercised in isolation. G2-04: S2-P1-02 multi-skill DB assertion changed from toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2) to toBe(2) (exact count). G2-05: clearReconcilePending() helper exported from lib/repos/skill.ts and called in TS-002 beforeEach; module-level Set can no longer be vacuously populated from a prior test. G2-06: Gherkin body headings S2-P1-01b→S2-P2-01 and S2-P1-02b→S2-P2-02 (coverage table was already correct). G2-07: Gherkin overview header updated from 15 to 16 tests. Confirmed-kept: F-01 TS-002 real injection, F-02 cross-profile rejection, F-04 BR-02 both-no-write, F-06 non-tautological, F-07 AC-23 beforeEach, F-08 SDK relabel, TADR-S2-01 v2 binding payloads. Total tests: 16 (unchanged). All 16 fail RED for the right reason.
